Version-only PATCH is a valid no-field edit that increments version.
Single-process synchronous SQLite and orderly close/reopen are the declared task topology.
limitations: No production identity, TLS, deployment, backup restore, crash/power-loss durability, filesystem privilege, disk pressure or cross-process contention verification.
No global request admission/connection bound or capacity benchmark; body buffer cap is per request.
One instrumentation wrapper exit 1 is retained; corrected runner records application exit 0 without suppressing raw SQLite stderr warning.
Five-second slow-body timeout implemented but not timing-tested.
Actual token usage and cost are not exposed by the host.
Independent child review was attempted but unavailable because the agent thread limit was reached.
